tasks.title: Translate the museum's braille labels
tasks.description: Convert two paragraphs of gallery labels into contracted braille and proof against the visitor-center style sheet.

tasks.title: Emboss and assemble the tactile city map
tasks.description: Translate two paragraphs of map labels into contracted braille, proof them against the organization's style sheet, then emboss and bind the overlays.

tasks.title: Install the ready-made braille map
tasks.description: Unpack a finished embossed wall map, use the mounting template to drill the anchors, hang it, and check its height with a visitor.

tasks.title: Seal a zinc downspout seam
tasks.description: Form and solder a one-meter joint in zinc sheet, then direct water over it and inspect for leakage.

tasks.title: Write the gallery roof report
tasks.description: Summarize the contractor's photographs of a repaired zinc seam, quote the supplied water-test results and attach the work order to the facilities ticket.

tasks.title: Patch and water-test the gallery roof drain
tasks.description: Crimp a replacement seam along one meter of sheet zinc, solder the joint and check the repair with a bucket before resealing the surrounding curb.

tasks.title: Approve the imported plant list
tasks.description: The labels are already entered and verified. Review the imported list size and email the existing report to the nursery curator.

tasks.title: Catalog and germinate a seed accession
tasks.description: Transcribe all eight collection labels into the plant register and compare rows with the originals. Then sow the accessions in a humidity tray.

tasks.title: Enter the lichen collection slips
tasks.description: Key eight dried specimen slips into the collections table. Verify the catalog number and place on each saved row against the paper.

tasks.title: Clean the spare treadle
tasks.description: Remove the faceplate and lint buildup, oil the service points, reassemble and stitch a trial seam.

tasks.title: Service and demonstrate the treadle machine
tasks.description: Remove the faceplate, clean lint from the feed dogs, oil the marked points and test the stitches. Then film a five-minute demonstration for the repair cafe.

tasks.title: Present the treadle service video
tasks.description: Play a supplied five-minute recording at the repair cafe and thank the demonstrator. The machine was serviced before the meeting.

tasks.title: Build the balloon calibration widget
tasks.description: Implement a web form that will later accept pressure profiles and correction curves. No measurements or curves are available; deliver form code and UI tests.

tasks.title: Calibrate the lake depth logger
tasks.description: Fit a correction curve to pressure readings against three supplied reference depths and plot the residuals for the sensor notebook.

tasks.title: Make and correct the balloon sounding
tasks.description: Launch a weather balloon and retrieve the pressure profile, then fit a correction curve against three logged reference heights and plot residuals.

tasks.title: Carve the new tile master
tasks.description: Use gouges to carve a hardwood positive master for a replacement mould. There is no plaster mould or liquid slip in this session.

tasks.title: Cast the replacement address tile
tasks.description: Use the existing plaster mould to slip-cast one tile, drain the excess, release it and trim the edges before drying.

tasks.title: Cast a new tile and touch up the studio mould
tasks.description: Cast one slip tile in the existing plaster mould, drain, release and trim the tile, then plug two tiny surface chips on the mould.
